facts: The Madison Road branch page links curbside pickup and delivery. For branch-specific questions, it lists 513-533-2600.
The Fresh Market ON Madison Rd
The chain’s curbside instructions say to order online, choose a time and have groceries brought to your car. They do not describe this branch’s collection bay or promise help lifting items.
Shop online, pick a time and we’ll bring your groceries out to your car with a smile.
The chain offers online or app ordering. In the app, log in or create an account, then choose curbside pickup or delivery.
Visit us online at shop.thefreshmarket.com or download our App!
Log in or create your account, then select whether you’d like curbside pickup or delivery to start your order.
The chain FAQ currently lists a curbside fee of $1.99 for orders of $35 or more and $3.99 below $35. Check the total at checkout; the FAQ says Instacart sets its delivery fees.
For curbside, orders totaling $35 and up, the fee is $1.99. For orders under $35, the fee is $3.99. Fees for delivery orders are set by our delivery partner, Instacart.

The chain’s delivery page names Instacart, DoorDash and Uber Eats and describes delivery to the doorstep. Delivery availability and timing need confirmation for the chosen address; indoor carrying is not described.
We’ve partnered with Instacart , DoorDash and Uber Eats to bring your favorite foods to your doorstep in 2 hours or less.
